candidate.description: Apply the existing Timoshenko kappa=0.5 pipe frame profile to numerical BEND_ARC chord members while leaving B31J factors, loads, geometry, restraints, solver, recovery, tolerances and references unchanged.

authorityBoundary.hexagonB31JStatement: CAESAR II B31J flexibility calculations apply to rotational moment stiffness; translational stiffness associated with the B31J flexibility calculation is rigid.
authorityBoundary.hexagonBendAxialShapeStatement: Bend Axial Shape controls a distinct axial displacement mode of the curved bend and disabling it makes the bend stiffer.
authorityBoundary.primarySourceSearchResult: No Hexagon/Intergraph primary source found that extends the retained straight-pipe shear=2 authority to bend arcs or defines a production bend-arc shear coefficient.

sourceReplayNumericalClosure.interpretation: The approximately 0.095 action replay closure is essentially unchanged by the candidate and is a separate condensation/numerical-precision issue; it is orders of magnitude smaller than the hundreds-unit CAESAR bend compatibility mismatches used for mechanism discrimination.

decision.reason: Applying transverse shear compliance to bend-arc chords substantially improves CAESAR endpoint replay for the dominant failed bends, but the only retained CAESAR shear coefficient authority explicitly covers straight metallic pipe. L3/L14 also regress while thermal strain authority remains provisional. A curved-bend CAESAR stiffness/shear source is required before any production implementation.
